controls: Normal local diagnosis, editing, no-send testing, necessary non-mutating external reads, and owner-requested local commits require no startup governance step.
Protected actions require fresh, specific owner approval immediately before execution, bound to the exact target and intended effect.
Remote pushes, deployments, sends, external writes, database/schema changes, credential/property/access changes, financial actions, and Production writes or changes are protected actions.
Read-only Production diagnosis is permitted only when narrowly necessary, minimal, and non-mutating.
Batch communication prohibited unless freshly and specifically approved.
A stale or blanket approval does not authorize a materially changed target or effect.
sensitiveData: Do not store secrets, tokens, credentials, secure links, applicant data or personal data.
